translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Lucas Dummad-Teófiloga narmaksiid
Ar dule-bukidargus bato nue-inikii igar-napiragwad anmar-abargi-gusad narmaksaye sogdidimalando,
ar gebesaila Jesús-sapingan na e-sunnad Jesús-daksamalad, igi anmar-odurdaksamala, amarde, Bab-Jesús-igargi sunmakdii-gusmalad.
Dummad-Teófilo, nue an baiganse egichisad-sorba, an dakmogua, ib-nueddo, Jesús-igar gebesaila onoded-akar, nue ilekwaa bega an narmaker,
adi be nue wisgumogagar Jesús-igargi-be-odurdaklesad we napiragwadid, gakansulid.
Anger sogsa-gusad, Juan-Bautista gwalulegoye
Rey-Herodes, Judea-yargi neg-dakmaigu, deun dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-wargwen, Abías-sikid, mai-gusad. A-dulede Zacarías-nugad, e-omedi Aarón-wagan-sikidid, Elisabetye-nugad.
Emide ebobela Bab-Dummad-asabin dule-igar-napiragwadba-damalad gumalad, degine, Bab Dummad egi ibmar akar-soged sated. Bab-na-e-igar-uksadba, degine, Bab-Dummad-sogsadbali-nanadimalad-dulemalad.
Ar amarde mimmi-satemalad, ar ade Elisabet geg mimmi-baked, degine, bato amarde sered gusmarbalid.
Ibagwengine, Abías-sikmaladga wilub nonikid Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi arbaegar. Deunni, Zacarías Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-golega arbanonimogad.
Na gusgu igi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormala, deyob Zacarías nugsalealid, Bab-Dummad-Neg-Islidikidgi dogegar, ina-wawadikid ase obupurmaknaegar.
Degine, ina-wawadikid-ogumaked-wachigi, deun bela-dulemar magaba Bab Dummadse gorbukwa-gusmalad.
Zacarías Bab-Dummad-Neg-Islidikidgi ina-wawadikid ogumaknaidgi, Bab-Dummad-anger-wargwen, Zacaríasse ukiar magargunonikid, daklealid ina-wawadik ogumakleged-galu-naba, argan-nuedsik gwichi.
Zacarías deyob Bab-Dummad-anger-dakargu, gwakided, bela nue-dobee ito naded.
Ar angerdi ega sogded: “Zacarías, melle dobgu, ar Bab-Dummadse-be-goledi Bab Dummad be-itosad, be-ome-Elisabet bega machi-wargwen-bakoed, e-nug Juanye be onugsao.
Be machi-nikuoedba, be yeer itogoed, be weligwar itogoed, degine, be-machi gwalulenonikir, bukidar egi weligwar itomarmogoed.
“Ar be-machide Bab-Dummad-asabin dule-dummadga guoed. Vino, degi, inna-gaibid gobosulid, degine, amba muu-neggi mai, bato Bab Dummad Burba Nued bela-bela nika-guoed.
Deginbali, we-machi gannar Bab-Dummad-Jehováse, Israel-dulemar-bukidar obirnai-guoed.

Ar be-machi-Juan, Dule-Dummad-idu nadap-guoed, Elíasyob. Deyob Bab-Dummad-Burba, degi, Bab-Dummad-gangued nika-gumogoed, adi babgan gannar na e-mimmigangi binsa imakegar, sabguegar, degi, dulemar-galagwensuli-gudimalad dulemar-nuegan-binsaed-nikaa-damaladga imakegar, degine, adi, dulemar guagwar urbegar, Bab-Dummad-abingamalagar.”
Degi Zacarías angerga sogded: —¿Degite igi an wisguosunna be-anga-soged we deyob guoed? Ar ande seredgusad, degi, an-omede bato seredgusmogad.
Anger, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Ani an Gabriel, Bab-Dummad-asabin an gwichid, Bab-Dummad-sogedba an ibmar imakegar. Ani an barmilealid, bega sunmakegar, bega we-gaya-burba-nued sogegar.
We-ibmar-an-bega-sogsad e-ibagan mosale, we deyob gunonikoed. Ar be an-bengussoggu, geg bar sunmak be guoed. Be-machi-gwalulesad-sorba geb be gannar sunna sunmak-gunonibaloed.
Ar dulemardi magaba Zacarías-edarbebukmalad, geger dakarmalad, ibiga dikasurgus Bab-Dummadse-goled-Neg-Islidikidgi Zacarías gunaid yoggud-dibeye.

Zacarías agi noargu, geg emarga sunmaked. Agi mag daksamala, we Bab-Dummadse-goled-Neg-Islidikidgi wis ibya-apurus danikir-gebye. Zacarías dulemarga sunmaksasulid, unnila argangi emarga wis sunmaksad.
Geb Zacarías dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-imaked bergusgu, na e-negse nadsunnad.
Geb a-ibagan-sorbali, e-ome-Elisabet gurgin-nika gunonikid. Agine, Elisabet nii-walatar bar nodsuli na neg-yaba megisad. Agi sokalid:
“Bab Dummad nabir an-daknonikid, an mimmi sulidba, adi dulemar mer istar bar an-dakmalaga anga mimmi-uknonikid.”
Anger, Maríaga sognonikid, Jesús gwalulegoye
Elisabet nii-walanergwagus bonigwar gudiidgi, Bab Dummad, anger-Gabriel-barmialid, Galilease, Nazaret-neggweburse,
yagwa-gwensak María-nugadse. A-yagwade, dule-wargwen, José-nugad-ebo igar-nabosad, na nikumalagar. Joséde Rey-David-wagwad.
Bia-María-maidse anger dognonigu, ega sognonikid: —¡Na, degite! ¡Bab Dummad begi nabir binsasad! Bab Dummad beba gudiguad. Baigan-omeganba Bab Dummad bur nued begi binsasad.
Ar Maríadi anger-dakargu, ibmar-ega-sogedba dobe ito naded, binsaded, wede anger weyob anse gornonikid ibi obarsunye.
Degi anger ega sogdesunnad: —María, mer be dobgu, ar Bab Dummad nabir begi binsasad.
Ar emigindi, be gurgin-nika gunonikoed, mimmi-gwensak be nikuoed, Jesúsye a-machigwa be onugsaoed.
We-machide dule-dummad guoed, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Dummadid a-e-Machiye soglegoed, degine, Bab Dummad, anmar-Dummad, igi epenne Rey-David, reyga mai-gusa, deyob e-wagwa-imakmogoed.
Degine, we-Jesús, Israel-neggwebur-neg-dakmai degi-sadeguoed, e-neg-dakmai-guoedi gwen bar berguosulid.
Geb degi María angerga sogded: —¿Ar wede igi guosunna? Ar amba an yaagwad.

Anger abin-imakdegu ega sogded: —Bab Dummad Burba Nued begi aidenonikoed, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Dummadid a-e-gangued be-edunonikoed. Degisoggu, Dule-gwage-swilidikid-gwalulegoed, soglenonikoed, Bab-Dummad-Machiye.
Emi be-gwenad-Elisabet, bato sered gusadgi, geg mimmi-bakye-nik sogmaladi bonigwar gunonikid. Emide nii-walanergwagus gurgin-nika gudiid.
Ar ade Bab Dummadgardi ibmar-geg-gued nik-deeye soglesulid, ar bela ega ibmar nabir guedbiid. Deggisoggu, a-ular an bega sogsadyob bega gunonimogoed.
Geb degi María sogdesun: —Ar andi Bab-Dummad-mai gued, ar be-ibmar-sogedba be anga imakdo. Degi anger Maríagi banguded.
María, Elisabetse atakapid
A-ibagangi, María Judá-yalaganba, a-neggwebur-gwagwense gwae nade-gusad.
Zacarías-negse dogdapgu, Elisabetse gordapid.
Elisabet itosgu, María ese gole, dule-e-sapi-dukugi-maid ber dulagwar itoded, degi, Elisabet bela-bela Bab Dummad Burba Nued nika-gunonikid.
Degine, Elisabet binnasur gote, sogded: —Baigan-omeganba Bab Dummad begi bur nued binsasad, degine, be-anagi bur-nued egi binsasbalid.
¿Ar wede ibiga weyob angi nued binsalesa, emide, an-Dummad-e-nan anse ataknonigu?
Ar be anse gornonikid an itodeyalaba, an-sapi-dukugi-maid weligwar-itogedba ber dulagwar naded.
Ar be we-ibmar bengussulidba begi nued-binsalesad, ar Bab-Dummad-bega-ibmar-sogsadba we-ibmar bela bega guoed.
Geb degi María sogdemogad:

content.text: ar emigindi, bela dulemar angi sogmaloed,
Ar Bab Dummad dulemar-e-dobee-nanadimalad wile daked,
Bab Dummad e-gangued na e-arbaedgi oyosad,

content: María, Elisabet-walik nii-walapaa megialid, geb a-sorba na e-negse gannar ali-gusad.
Juan-Bautista gwalulesad
Elisabet e-ibagan warmaknonigu, mimmi-nikunonikid, machigwa ega uklenonikid.
E-neg-dikarba-mamaid, degine, e-gwenadgan itoarmargu, Bab Dummad Elisabetgi nabir binsasye, degi, nue wile daksaye, Elisabetba wergudmarmogad.
Degine, ibabaabakgus susugwa-gwalulesad-sorba senonimalad, e-abgan-duku sikegar, adi Moisés-igar-maidba imakegar. Degine, e-bab-Zacaríasba mimmi nug-imakarmalad.
Ar e-nan sunmakdegu, sogded: —Suli, degi nugguosur. Juanye nugguoed.
Elisabetga sogdemalad: —¿Ibiga degi be onugsabie? Ar be-gwenadgan degi-gwen-nugsurmalad.
Geb degi e-babse egichiarmalad, argangi sunmakar, igi machigwa onugsaoye.
Zacarías urgo-bipigwa egichisad, agi machigwa-nug narmaksad, Juanye nugguoye. Bukmaladi bela geger dakdemalad, deyob onugsabied.
Geb degi Zacarías nabir sunmakded, e-gwabin bipinmakded. Sunmakdegu, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannoded.
Bela-e-neg-dikarba-mamaid dobe itonadmalad. Bela Judea-yalaganba we-ibmar-deyob-gusadi gaya mimmileded.
Ar bela-we-gayagan-itoarmalad na nue e-gwagegi binsadmalad, sogdemalad: “¿Ar we-mimmide doaga guosunna?” Dulemar daksamalad, a-mimmiba Bab-Dummad-gangued gudigu.
Iduakwaa-ibmar-guoed Zacarías sogsad
Degi Zacarías, Juan-e-bab, Bab Dummad Burba Nued bela-bela nika gunonikid, degi, Bab-Dummad-nuggi sunmakdesunnad, sogded:

content.text: Adi Bab Dummad anmar-babgan wile dakega,

content: Degine, machigwa dungumai, e-burba gangumai gusad. Nega-dule-sulidganba gudigusad, Israel-dulemarse na san magaros gusadse, Bab-Dummad-igargi sunmakegar.
